newsitem.title: USA: General Re completes merger with National Reinsurance.
newsitem.headline: General Re completes merger with National Reinsurance.

text.p: General Re Corp said Thursday it has completed its acquisition of National Re Corp, expecting to pay $308 million in cash to about 35 percent of National Re's stockholders who elected to take $53 a share rather than General Re stock.

The rest of National Re's stockholders will receive receive 0.37262 share of General Re common stock for each share of National Re stock they own. In total, General Re said it will be issuing about 4,026,000 shares to National Re stockholders as part of a deal valued previously at $940 million.
Under the terms, at least 50 percent of the deal had to be done in stock for the merger to be tax-free.
General Re, the largest professional reinsurer in the United States, reached a definitive agreement in July to acquire National Re.
